program.name: Bell Pilates 35
program.subject: Kettlebell Pilates
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of kettlebell Pilates: core one day, glutes and sides the next.
program.about: Kettlebell Pilates for about half an hour. One day is bell core moves with the abdominal series; the other bell bridges, pliés and side work. Both open with the hundred and close with rolling. They alternate. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Bell core / bell glutes & sides, 35 minutes
